/qst do <questId> - highlights the specified quest in the debug overlay (requires debug overlay to be enabled)
/qst do - clears the highlighted quest in the debug overlay (requires debug overlay to be enabled)
/qst next <questId> - sets the next quest to do (or clears it if no questId is specified)
/qst sim <questId> [sequence] [step] - simulates the specified quest (or clears it if no questId is specified)
/qst which - shows all quests starting with your selected target
/qst zone - shows all quests starting in the current zone (only includes quests with a known quest path, and currently visible unaccepted quests)
/qst journal - toggles the Journal Progress window
/qst mountid - prints information about your current mount
/qst handle-interrupt - makes Questionable handle queued interrupts immediately (useful if you manually start combat)
